# rerankers

> A lightweight, unified Python API for reranking models — from cross-encoders and ColBERT to LLM-based rankers and multi-modal VLMs — enabling seamless integration of state-of-the-art reranking into any retrieval pipeline.

`rerankers` unifies cross-encoder, ColBERT/late-interaction, FlashRank, RankGPT, RankLLM, MonoVLM, MxBai, and API-based rerankers (Cohere, Jina, Pinecone, etc.) behind a single `Reranker` interface. The core package ships dependency-free; extras are installed only for the backends you need.

---

### rerankers.models.upr

*Source: rerankers/models/upr.py | URL: https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/rerankers/blob/main/rerankers/models/upr.py*

- `UPRRanker`: UPR (Unsupervised Passage Reranker) replicates the negative log-likelihood
- `score`: Score a single document. Negative log-likelihood of 'query' given 'doc'.
- `rank`: Ranks a list of documents by the negative log-likelihood of the query given the doc.

### rerankers.reranker

*Source: rerankers/reranker.py | URL: https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/rerankers/blob/main/rerankers/reranker.py*

- `Reranker`

### rerankers.results

*Source: rerankers/results.py | URL: https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/rerankers/blob/main/rerankers/results.py*

- `Result`
- `RankedResults`
- `results_count`: Returns the total number of results.
- `top_k`: Returns the top k results based on the score, if available, or rank.
- `get_score_by_docid`: Fetches the score of a result by its doc_id using a more efficient approach.
- `get_result_by_docid`: Fetches a result by its doc_id using a more efficient approach.

### rerankers.utils

*Source: rerankers/utils.py | URL: https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/rerankers/blob/main/rerankers/utils.py*

- `vprint`
- `make_documents`
- `prep_docs`
- `prep_image_docs`: Prepare image documents for processing. Can handle base64 encoded images or file paths.
- `get_chunks`: Implementation from https://github.com/unicamp-dl/InRanker/blob/main/inranker/base.py with extra typing and more descriptive names.
